folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B380: finite treatment and later drift boundaries
folds.body:
The complete checkpoint and [coverage table](COVERAGE.md) were read in chronological order. The first27checked/26open split and N1–N5 incomplete stop are followed by an explicit solo extension and final bounded release. All53 named treatments means the selected native example for each checklist entry, not every world/illustration in each family or adoption of90 source comparisons. The26 expanded rows and27 earlier styling/IG rows retain different proof receipts. Their hashes and full/focused/browser runs are attributed historical evidence, not freshly revalidated.

Preserve actual distinctions from every coverage row: loose stock is not paid fuel; a one-sided cold threshold invents no heat-safe interval; signed regeneration contributions are not net combat flow; discrete/unequal work allocation does not grant partial atomic output; observed prior-visit facts name their last observation; same-copy deltas do not confuse capacity change with repair/healing. Crafting intent is session-only and reserves nothing, while a processing routine keeps its finite target/tally through its specified pause/resume/cancel contract. Carried output destination and exact chest custody remain native. Known body/skill response has a full cause in Body, not a new capability, cost, hidden tint or reward.

The final body-compaction inputs, immediately preceding unchanged firewood inputs and earlier full suite are not interchangeable. Post-verification household animal/control-continuity changes are preserved concurrent work outside the frozen release;736matching release inputs cannot certify that later candidate. Queued app opening does not prove visible delivery or adopted runtime. Old preview URLs/PIDs and finished-worker claims are historical, not live handles to stop or restart. Later functional-home/prose-first direction qualifies the old illustration; current AD42 makes human taste feedback optional. No old usage extension, source collection, agent dispatch, adoption, commit/push or new gameplay is renewed.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B380: recovery, source review and implementation remain distinct
folds.body:
This full recovery checkpoint and all follow-ups through CRL52 were read. Preserve exact original-request set, source-post/context association, retained old manifests, originals versus one WebP derivative, complete decoding and separately qualified review ranges. Recovering26files does not establish gallery browser rendering, listened audio, executed source HTML/save, whole large-game-file reading or gameplay. The follow-up explicitly decoded but did not listen to audio and read large files in focused spans; those limits remain independent of hash/decode success. No private attachment, source excerpt or linked full review body was newly read in this reconciliation.

The useful semantic questions stay at their owners: earned/held versus selected title, capability source versus activation, actual ongoing running-cost hook, recipient's next opportunity, paired material-acquisition insight and genuine practice effects. Material/observation/expertise lifecycles, mixed-stock estimate scope, stale preview commitment, glyph/anchor meaning, catch-up learning midpoint and reload entitlement versus replayed cues remain useful checks. SLR40–SLR43 clarify title/skill/source/effect ownership without changing runtime title stacking, save schema or activation semantics. The old shared-source full suite supports its own slice and does not verify every new rule meaning.

Creation of the separately requested implementation chat, sent broader addendum and tool-side message delivery are handoff evidence, not implemented native behavior. The [title/detail implementation owner](../title-rules-implementation-2026-10-21/CHECKPOINT.md) owns its actual delivery. Old model/ceiling/chat/PID/source routes remain history and confer no new messaging, acquisition, agents or source execution authority. Current AD42 makes human review optional. Original useful design, source attribution and private locators stay intact; no excerpts or altered hidden truths are published here.
